name: Cinderwake
description: A small red dwarf with a volcanic world trailing embers and a cold rock in its wake. The inner world resurfaces yearly while the outer one never changes. The contrast draws geologists from three sectors.

stars.name: Cinderwake Dim
stars.description: A red dwarf with a restless flare cycle and long patient calms between. Its planets crowd close to catch the thin light. Every outburst rewrites the inner sky.

planets.name: Wakefire
planets.description: A volcanic world trailing embers through the red dwarf's wind, resurfacing yearly. Lava fountains play against crushing fume skies. Foundries harvest crust younger than their crews.

planets.name: Wakeice
planets.description: A cold rock in the ember's wake, unchanged since formation and proud of it. Its craters hold the system's oldest ice. Geologists call it the control sample for everything.
